notes.title: ⚔️⛩️ Momogatari - Demo Update Live! ⛩️⚔️
notes.content:
Hello adventurers! 🌟

We are thrilled to announce that the latest Beta update for Momogatari is now available for everyone on Steam! 🎮✨

This update brings:


     New features to explore (Skills Tree, Boss Fight...)
     Improved gameplay mechanics
     And a host of fixes based on feedbacks from older versions (Controllers Rebind, UI navigation via buttons ...)


⚠️ Note: While this version is more polished, you might still encounter minor bugs. Your feedback continues to be invaluable as we refine Momogatari! 🛠️

🎮 How to access the Beta:
Simply update your game on Steam, and you're good to go!

📢 We want your feedback!


     Share your thoughts, suggestions, or bug reports in the Community Hub.
     Join the discussion with fellow players and our team via Discord!


Thank you so much for your support. Your passion and feedback help us make Momogatari the best it can be. 

Happy exploring, and see you in the game! 🌸✨

notes.title: New Patch 0.9.1 available
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have identified the issue causing a lag that makes the game unplayable as you may have noticed.

A fix has been made and it has been pushed yesterday.

Sorry again for the inconvenience, and I hope you enjoy the game with the new Patch.
